## Project overview

For this project, I collected county-level motor-vehicle crash-death
data and combined the state CSV exports into one dataset.

## Preparing the data

I added a State column to each dataset, removed the state-total row,
and combined the remaining county rows.

## Next steps

I will check for missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistent
column types before analyzing the combined dataset.
